verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a pip-installable orchestration library whose graphs are invoked programmatically, for example through the stream/astream methods and by re-invoking the graph with Command. Its official CLI builds and runs the Agent Server locally, exposing API endpoints for runs and threads, so it can operate without a UI. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI usage or headless automation recipes specifically. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, headless/non-interactive run guidance for the CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: LangGraph graphs expose the stream (sync) and astream (async) methods to yield streamed outputs as iterators.
LangGraph CLI is a command-line tool for building and running the Agent Server locally. The resulting server exposes all API endpoints for runs, threads, assistants, etc.
